about: Elected officials, department leaders and 2026 local candidates named in the site's datasets, one id per person. Names are matched on first and last name with common nicknames (Doug = Douglas, Chris = Christopher, Dave = David ...), ignoring middle initials, titles and notes in parentheses; "(D2)" style suffixes become the district field. People who appear under more than one government are listed in multi_government for checking. No other people are included.
